heading: Data usage

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Director shall provide the sampling data collected under section 8933 of this title to—

children.text: other Federal and State regulatory agencies on request.

tree.heading: Usage
tree.text: The sampling data provided under subsection (a) shall be used to inform and enhance assessments of exposure, likely health and environmental impacts, and remediation priorities.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 116–92, div. F, title LXXIII, § 7334, Dec. 20, 2019, 133 Stat. 2283.)
